$comment: Heartbeats for staging (spec 01 §8.5). Grace periods come from the overlay (grace.<name>, OB-13). Each heartbeat URL is resolved at run time and set as a sealed variable of the one Railway service that pings it (holders); it is never committed or printed. The watcher (a Worker) and the scheduled pnpm fin verify are not Railway services: watcher deploy and pnpm fin verify read their own URLs from Better Stack at run time, so their holders are empty. The apply pauses a heartbeat the files drop, never deletes it (OB-16), and counts each pause against the MA-03 cap.

heartbeats.name: watcher
heartbeats.pingedBy: the watcher, after each run (its secret FIN_HEARTBEAT_WATCHER_URL, which watcher deploy reads from Better Stack)

heartbeats.name: scheduler-worker
heartbeats.pingedBy: worker's scheduler, each minute it holds the lease

heartbeats.name: email-delivery-check
heartbeats.pingedBy: worker, after the delivery check sends (S0-09)

heartbeats.name: verify-daily
heartbeats.pingedBy: the scheduled pnpm fin verify, which reads its URL from Better Stack at run time
